metadata.description: Nova-Violet Role: RoT DtD Commander. Claude Code commands, skills and agents with a declared DTD grammar and trust boundary, the Adiutor Stop-hook doctor, and the Commander-Adiutor monitor.

plugins.name: rot-dtd-commander
plugins.description: 68 -dtd commands (the nine RoT MoE lenses and ELEVATE among them), 19 skills, 4 agents, the Adiutor: a Stop hook that checks every -dtd answer against the DOCTYPE of the command that produced it, a ledger, and the /RoT-DtD-Commander-Adiutor doctor; and the Commander-Adiutor: a monitor that hands every failed answer to the session as the ledger closes it.
